body:
Yo people I got to try the compound DOC recently. I thought it was rather interesting. No denying feeling it three hours after ingestion, and from there I was pretty much out there for about 12-15 hours. Certainly like DOI and DOB in the fact that it lingers on for about a full 24 hours, or just whenever I get some sleep. Very good chemical for hard thinking. My friend and I stayed up all night and felt like kids again. Lots of laughing in the onset. The beginning of the experience is like a high. A rather strong one too. By the peak at about 5 hours there is no denying psychedelic activity.
The only drawback is the next day I feel sort of dissociated from reality. Not as bad as an MDMA hangover or anything, but certainly notable. I would almost say that the second day DOC, and DOI act as mild dissociatives. Great stuff though to say the least. Stamped with the psychonaut approval!
